Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Ish Smith?

Ish Smith is 38 years old.

Where was Ish Smith born?

Ish Smith was born in Charlotte, North Carolina.

When was Ish Smith born?

Ish Smith was born on July 5, 1988.

How tall is Ish Smith?

Ish Smith is 6-0 (183 cm) tall.

How much did Ish Smith weigh when playing?

Ish Smith weighed 175 lbs (79 kg) when playing.

Is Ish Smith in the Hall of Fame?

Ish Smith is not in the Hall of Fame.

What position did Ish Smith play?

Point Guard.

When did Ish Smith retire?

Ish Smith last played in 2024.

What is Ish Smith's net worth?

Ish Smith made at least $47,226,186 playing professional basketball.

How much did Ish Smith make?

Ish Smith made $6,000,000 in 2017.

What did Ish Smith average?

Ish Smith averaged 7.1 points, 2.4 rebounds, and 3.8 assists per game.

How many rings does Ish Smith have?

Ish Smith won one championship.

What is Ish Smith's Instagram account?

Ish Smith is on Instagram at ishsmith5.

What schools did Ish Smith attend?

Ish Smith attended Central Cabarrus in Concord, North Carolina and Wake Forest.

What are Ish Smith's nicknames?

Ish is a nickname for Ish Smith.
